title.en: MiniMax M2: Long-Text Workloads, Model IDs, and Media Limits

description.en: Review MiniMax M2’s exact ID and configured low-cost 1M profile. Examine long-text workloads and media limits while keeping configuration separate from selectable access.
description.zh: 查看 MiniMax M2 的准确模型 ID 与已配置的低成本 1M 画像，了解长文本工作负载和媒体能力边界；实际使用前核对可选入口，避免把配置参数当作开放承诺。

title.en: MiniMax M2 model, 1M context profile, and long-text capabilities.
title.zh: MiniMax M2 模型、1M 上下文画像与长文本能力。

prompts.zh: 处理长文本低成本任务

value.zh: 旧记录未显示选择器入口

title.en: Prepared around the economics of long-running text work.
title.zh: 围绕长时间文本工作的经济性完成准备。

description.en: MiniMax M2 is differentiated by its configured 1M low-cost profile. Media integrations remain separate workflow paths.
description.zh: MiniMax M2 的差异来自已配置的 1M 低成本画像；视频与生图仍由独立工作流承载。

description.en: The capacity profile is designed around extended inputs.
description.zh: 容量画像围绕较长输入设计。

description.en: The configured role emphasizes economical processing.
description.zh: 已配置角色强调经济型处理。

description.en: Image and video integrations are not represented as chat-picker features.
description.zh: 图像与视频使用独立工作流，不属于当前聊天模型选择器中的功能。

description.en: There is no current public picker entry.
description.zh: 当前没有公开的选择器入口。

title.en: One exact model ID with a 1M profile.
title.zh: 一个准确 Model ID，对应 1M 画像。

description.en: The MiniMax record describes the configured M2 profile rather than a guaranteed picker entry. Review the identifier and task positioning with that boundary in mind, then establish current access before planning work around the recorded capacity.
description.zh: MiniMax 记录描述的是已配置 M2 画像，而非保证存在的选择器入口。以下条目说明型号与任务定位；围绕容量安排实际工作前，仍需先确认当前访问条件。

description.en: 1M low-cost capacity profile.
description.zh: 1M 低成本容量画像。

meta.zh: 旧记录未显示选择器入口

description.zh: 长文本批次需要质量和资源样本，混合媒体又涉及独立访问路径。MiniMax 的容量记录可作为规划依据，但任务能否执行、各类输出怎样检查，仍须结合当前环境分别确认。
description.en: Long-text queues, resource planning, and mixed-media deliverables need separate batching and access decisions. Review the evidence each workflow would require before relying on recorded MiniMax capacity or assuming that text and media share an execution route.

A long-text queue needs a plan for volume, output requirements, and sample verification. Compare the input scale with recorded budgets and confirm access before defining batches. Use spot checks and exception handling to decide whether the queue can proceed under the required quality threshold.
description.zh: 处理长文本队列时，先明确数量、输出要求和核验样本，再将输入规模与已有预算记录进行比较。确认访问条件后制定分批规则，并通过抽样和例外处理判断质量是否达标，避免仅根据预计容量直接扩大处理规模。

description.en: Cost-aware adoption starts with representative tasks, quality thresholds, and response deadlines. Compare these needs with configuration records, then test the resource assumptions on pilot samples. Measurements should determine adoption criteria; an expected cost profile alone cannot establish the quality or timing of the actual workflow.
description.zh: 评估成本时，先选取有代表性的任务，明确质量门槛和响应时限，再对照配置记录提出需要验证的资源假设。使用小规模样本测量实际表现，并据此确定采用条件，不能只凭预期成本推断工作流的质量和耗时。

description.en: A deliverable containing text, images, and video may require separate model routes and dependencies. Identify the appropriate path for each medium, verify its access requirements, and review the resulting output independently. Keep those boundaries visible when assembling the overall workflow instead of treating every medium as one text request.
description.zh: 包含文本、图片和视频的交付任务，可能需要不同的模型入口与依赖条件。分别确定每种媒介的处理路径、访问要求和结果检查方式，再组合成整体工作流。保留这些边界，避免把所有媒介都理解为同一条文本请求能够处理的内容。

title.zh: 抽查批次输出中的遗漏

description.en: A completed text queue may still contain skipped records, inconsistent summaries, or lost conditions. Compare representative source items with the saved outputs and retain exceptions for review. If a model route is needed, confirm current access first; a recorded capacity profile does not establish that the audit can run in the present environment.
description.zh: 文本队列完成后，仍可能出现漏项、总结不一致或条件丢失。将代表性源记录与保存结果对照，把例外保留给审阅者。需要调用模型时，先确认当前访问条件；容量画像已经记录，并不能证明这次检查在现有环境中就能执行。

title.en: A focused economic profile below the picker.
title.zh: 选择器下层的一项明确经济画像。

description.en: The recorded M2 identity, text capacity, and resource positioning describe one part of a broader workflow. Compare them with the separate media paths, and verify each access condition before assuming that text configuration also enables image or video processing.
description.zh: M2 的身份、文本容量及资源定位描述的是已记录文本能力。图像或视频仍需沿独立媒体路径核对访问条件，不能从文本通道已经配置，推断所有制作任务也已具备执行入口。

description.en: The configured model ID is `minimax-m2`.
description.zh: 已配置 Model ID 为 `minimax-m2`。

description.en: The runtime matrix registers a 1M capacity profile.
description.zh: 运行时矩阵已登记 1M 容量画像。

description.en: Its recorded role emphasizes economical long workloads.
description.zh: 记录的角色强调经济型长任务。

description.en: Video and image integrations are carried by other workflows.
description.zh: 视频与图像集成由其他工作流承载。

title.en: Evaluate MiniMax M2 for long-text work and cost requirements.
title.zh: 结合长文本任务与成本要求评估 MiniMax M2。

items.en: Future workloads combine long input and cost sensitivity.
items.zh: 未来工作同时关注长输入与成本。

items.en: You need the exact configured MiniMax ID.
items.zh: 需要准确的 MiniMax 已配置 ID。

items.en: You are separating text capacity from media workflows.
items.zh: 需要区分文本容量与媒体工作流。

title.zh: 这些情况使用其他产品路径

items.en: You need a model that is selectable in the client now.
items.zh: 需要现在就能在客户端选择的模型。

items.en: The deliverable is an image or video.
You need confirmed public availability rather than configured capacity.
items.zh: 需要已确认的公开可用性，而不是已配置容量。

answer.en: MiniMax M2 is a model profile positioned for economical processing of long textual workloads.
answer.zh: MiniMax M2 是面向长文本工作负载经济型处理的模型画像。

question.en: What is the MiniMax M2 model ID?
question.zh: MiniMax M2 的 Model ID 是什么？

answer.en: The exact configured model ID is `minimax-m2`.
answer.zh: 准确配置的 Model ID 是 `minimax-m2`。

question.en: How large is the MiniMax M2 context profile?
question.zh: MiniMax M2 的上下文有多大？

answer.en: The registered economic profile carries a 1M capacity budget.
answer.zh: 已登记的经济画像包含 1M 容量预算。

question.en: What is MiniMax M2 best suited for?
question.zh: MiniMax M2 适合什么任务？

answer.en: Its confirmed role is long, cost-sensitive textual processing rather than image or video generation.
answer.zh: 其已确认定位是对成本敏感的长文本处理，而不是图像或视频生成。

question.en: What is the current MiniMax M2 support status?
question.zh: MiniMax M2 当前是什么支持状态？

answer.en: Its protocol and 1M economic profile are configured, but it was absent from the October 9, 2026 main-picker record; current access needs a fresh check.
answer.zh: 其协议与 1M 经济画像已配置，但旧记录未显示主选择器入口，当前需查看实际菜单。

question.en: What should I measure in a MiniMax multi-step coding trial?
question.zh: 用 MiniMax 测试多步骤编程时，应观察什么？

answer.en: Choose a small repository change with a reproducible check. Inspect the diff, tool failures, recovery, and test result, rather than scoring only the final explanation; this separates a convincing narrative from a working change.
answer.zh: 选择一项有可复现检查的小型代码改动，查看差异、工具失败、恢复过程和测试结果，而不只评价最终说明，区分有说服力的叙述与真正可用的改动。

title.en: Plan a text queue with batching and sample checks
title.zh: 为文本队列安排分批与抽样核对

description.en: Estimate input volume, output requirements, and review samples. Check the available MiniMax route and recorded budget before deciding how to batch the queue.
description.zh: 先估算输入量、输出要求和复核样本；核对可用的 MiniMax 入口及已记录预算，再决定队列如何分批处理。
